about: Every source that a prior or a rule uses. The CREDITS.md line is the text to copy. 'status' says if the terms are read and cleared. Rule F (the owner, 14 Nov): for AI models the publisher's weights licence is the gate; for data the data licence is the gate. Facts from copyrighted standards (MUTCD is federal; NFPA, AASHTO and USPS documents are not) are used as numbers only, never as copied text.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.terms: Overpass API main instances: fewer than 10,000 queries per day and less than 1 GB download per day; one request at a time; honour HTTP 429 and the /api/status slots. Geofabrik extracts: download each file once, no scripted re-downloads in a loop.
sources.derived: priors made from OSM are a derivative database: publish them under ODbL with the credit (the repo is public)

sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau, Survey of Construction (SOC) public-use microdata 1999-2025
sources.credit: U.S. Census Bureau, Survey of Construction microdata
sources.notes: variables used: DIV, STRT, WAL1, WAL2, STOR, BASE, FRAME, DET, CAT, GAR, PRCH, DECK, PATI, AREA, SQFS, MFGS, WEIGHT; no state field (division only); no roof field

sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year (B25024 units in structure, B25035 median year built, B25034 year built)
sources.credit: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey
sources.terms: the Census Data API terms of service require the notice: 'This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.' A free API key is advised for batch use.

sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line and cartographic boundary files (counties, 2020 urban areas)
U.S. Army Corps of Engineers National Structure Inventory, public base layer
sources.licence: US federal work, releasable to the general public
sources.credit: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers National Structure Inventory (USACE NSI)
sources.limits: public fields only: bldgtype, found_type, found_ht, num_story, med_yr_blt (and occtype for the use class). Never the restricted parcel fields (yrbuilt, p_extwall, p_construc, basement, naics, empnum, apn). No saved or bundled raw responses; the learning keeps only aggregate counts. p_extwall is not a label source.
sources.data_note: many bldgtype and found_type values are modelled from county shares, not seen; treat NSI as weak evidence and check its 'source' field

sources.name: USDA Forest Service TreeMap (FIA plots imputed to 30 m pixels; editions 2016, 2020, 2022)
sources.notes: each pixel points to an FIA plot, so the tree list (species, diameter, height, crown ratio) of a real plot comes with it

sources.name: USDA Forest Service Forest Inventory and Analysis DataMart
sources.credit: USDA Forest Service, Forest Inventory and Analysis
sources.notes: plot locations are fuzzed by design; use tree lists by plot, not exact positions

sources.name: LANDFIRE (EVT existing vegetation type, EVH height, EVC cover, CBH canopy base height, CC canopy cover)
sources.credit: LANDFIRE, U.S. Department of the Interior and USDA Forest Service

sources.name: MRLC NLCD and Annual NLCD land cover, USFS tree canopy cover
USGS 3D Elevation Program lidar and DEM
USGS National Hydrography Dataset / NHDPlus HR
sources.credit: U.S. Geological Survey National Hydrography Dataset

sources.name: FHWA Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (2009 edition values; 11th edition 2023 to confirm)
sources.status: cleared (numbers used; confirm section numbers in the 11th edition)

sources.name: USPS curbside mailbox guidance (height and set-back)
sources.credit: none needed for facts; name USPS in CREDITS as a reference

sources.name: NFPA 291 hydrant flow-class colours
sources.licence: copyrighted standard; colour classes used as facts only

sources.name: AASHTO Roadside Design Guide (clear zone, barrier warrants)
sources.licence: copyrighted; numbers used as facts only

sources.name: AASHTO A Policy on Geometric Design of Highways and Streets (side friction, superelevation)
sources.licence: copyrighted; numbers used as facts only

sources.name: Mapillary API map features (traffic signs, objects) and images
sources.licence: map features: free for personal and commercial use under the Mapillary terms; images CC BY-SA 4.0
sources.use: counts and tests only; never ship pixels
sources.status: planned v2.0.4; read the current API terms first

sources.name: USA National Phenology Network (leaf-out and leaf-colour timing)
sources.status: open: read the data use policy before use; Hopkins' rule is the fallback

sources.name: City open-data inventories (hydrants, street lights, street trees)
sources.use: completeness check of OSM (T1), never as a shipped layer unless the licence allows
sources.status: per city: record the licence in validation/README; skip a city whose terms are unclear

sources.name: Published US house-style field guides (for example McAlester, A Field Guide to American Houses)
sources.use: general knowledge of style by region and era only; no text, figures or tables copied

NSI restricted parcel fields (yrbuilt, p_extwall, p_construc, basement, naics, empnum, apn)
do_not_use.why: not part of the public base layer

do_not_use.name: Labels made with a commercial chat model
